```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

```{r}
mpg %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class, size = cyl)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", color = "black", se = FALSE) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Cylinders", range = c(2, 7)) +
  labs(
    title = "Highway Fuel Economy vs Engine Displacement",
    subtitle = "mpg dataset: vehicle class and engine configuration",
    x = "Engine displacement (liters)",
    y = "Highway mpg",
    color = "Vehicle class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
